form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Mr. Risch (for himself, Ms. Rosen, Mr. Hoeven, Mr. Crapo, Mrs. Capito, Ms. Cortez Masto, and Ms. Murkowski) introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Small Business and Entrepreneurship

form.official-title: To modify the Federal and State Technology Partnership Program of the Small Business Administration, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the FAST Fix Act of 2023.

section.header: Federal and State Technology Partnership Program
section.text: Section 34 of the Small Business Act (15 U.S.C. 657d) is amended—

paragraph.text: in subsection (a), by adding at the end the following:

The term underperforming State means a State participating in the SBIR or STTR program that has been calculated by the Administrator to be one of 18 States receiving the fewest SBIR and STTR Phase I awards.

subparagraph.text: in paragraph (1)—

subclause.text: in clause (iii), by striking and at the end;
in clause (iv), by striking the period at the end and inserting ; and; and
by adding at the end the following:

clause.text: to prioritize applicants located in an underperforming State.

subparagraph.text: in paragraph (2)(B)(vi)—

clause.text: in subclause (II), by striking and at the end; and
by adding at the end the following:

subclause.text: located in an underperforming State; and

subparagraph.text: in paragraph (3), by striking Not more than one proposal and inserting There is no limit on the number of proposals that; and
by adding at the end the following:

paragraph.text: Upon application by a recipient that is located in an underperforming State, the Administrator may—

subparagraph.text: provide additional assistance to the recipient; and
waive the matching requirements under subsection (e)(2).
in paragraph (2)—

subclause.text: by inserting and STTR before first phase each place that term appears;
in clause (i), by striking 50 and inserting 25; and
in clause (iii), by striking 75 and inserting 50;

clause.text: in subparagraph (D), by striking , beginning with fiscal year 2001 and inserting and make publicly available on the website of the Administration, beginning with fiscal year 2023; and
by adding at the end the following:

subparagraph.text: The non-Federal share of the cost of an activity carried out by a recipient may be paid by the recipient over the course of the period of the award or cooperative agreement.
by adding at the end the following:

paragraph.text: In carrying out the FAST program under this section—

subparagraph.text: the Administrator shall make and enter into awards or cooperative agreements;
each award or cooperative agreement described in subparagraph (A) shall be for not more than $500,000, which shall be provided over 2 fiscal years; and
any amounts left unused in the third quarter of the second fiscal year may be retained by the Administrator for future FAST program awards.

paragraph.text: Not later than 6 months after receiving an award or entering into a cooperative agreement under this section, a recipient shall report to the Administrator—

subparagraph.text: the number of awards made under the SBIR or STTR program;
the number of applications submitted for the SBIR or STTR program;
the number of consulting hours spent;
the number of training events conducted; and
any issues encountered in the management and application of the FAST program.
in paragraph (1)—

subclause.text: by striking Small Business Innovation Research Program Reauthorization Act of 2000 and inserting FAST Fix Act of 2023; and
by inserting and Entrepreneurship before of the Senate;

clause.text: in subparagraph (B), by striking and at the end;
in subparagraph (C), by striking the period at the end and inserting ; and; and
by adding at the end the following:

subparagraph.text: a description of the process used to ensure that underperforming States are given priority application status under the FAST program.
in paragraph (2)—

clause.text: in the paragraph heading, by striking Annual and inserting Biennial;
in the matter preceding subparagraph (A), by striking an annual and inserting a biennial;
in subparagraph (B), by striking and at the end;
in subparagraph (C), by striking the period at the end and inserting a semicolon; and
by adding at the end the following:

subparagraph.text: the proportion of awards provided to and cooperative agreements entered into with underperforming States; and
a list of the States that were determined by the Administrator to be underperforming States, and a description of any changes in the list compared to previously submitted reports.
by striking 2004 and inserting 2023; and
by inserting and Entrepreneurship before of the Senate; and

paragraph.text: in subsection (h)(1), by striking $10,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2001 through 2005 and inserting $20,000,000 for every 2 fiscal years between fiscal years 2023 through 2027, to be obligated before the end of the second fiscal year.
